notes.title: Teravit Global Alpha Test Announcement
notes.content:
Greetings 鋼鉄戦記C21 players!

We would like to announce that [b]the Global Alpha Test for CyberStep's latest title "Teravit" will be available[/b] from October 12th, 2021 15:00 (JST)!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38839804/e51d99c9a31addae35c045943181eecf3993ef1e.png[/img]

For the Global Alpha Test, voxel avatars can now be applied in Teravit.



[h2]What is Teravit?[/h2]Teravit is a multiplayer, open-world sandbox RPG that gives you the freedom to explore and adventure in a vast and diverse fantasy voxel world.

https://www.youtube.com/embed/NgQEmBPqcHI
- Teravit Store Page
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1743650/Teravit/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1743650/Teravit/[/url]


[h2]Exploring as Crimrose!? Create your own voxel avatar![/h2]During Teravit's Global Alpha Test, you will be able to edit your player character's avatar!

[h3]Let's use an Official Avatar![/h3]Teravit will be providing users with several voxel avatars that can be used during the Global Alpha Test. 

- Avatar Distribution Page
[url=https://teravit.app/en/download/avatar]https://teravit.app/en/download/avatar[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38839804/7b6ff7720d7e3e6cfe9790cbe7160247b98933d2.jpg[/img]

[h3]Let's make our own voxel avatar![/h3]You can make your own original avatar using MagicaVoxel!
For more information on how to download and install MagicaVoxel, and how to create and customize voxels, please visit the Avatar Distribution Page.
If we can enjoy Teravit using original characters, then why don't we recreate some of the 鋼鉄戦記C21 characters?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38839804/b5f46dc8bd158fcfa3160b9849b1a1fcebdd215b.jpg[/img]

- Avatar Distribution Page
[url=https://teravit.app/en/download/avatar]https://teravit.app/en/download/avatar[/url]


[h2]About the Global Alpha Test[/h2]During the Japanese Alpha Test in September, we received a lot of feedback and requests from players. We will be incorporating this feedback from the first Alpha Test in the Global Alpha Test on Steam.

The Global Alpha Test will be available from October 12th, 2021 (JST) until October 29th, 2021 (JST).



We hope to see everyone in Teravit and 鋼鉄戦記C21!
